{{Top|leg}}
'''Reeds''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some breeds grew in spongy and wet ground, clustered in close bundles with wide bases that tapered into long stalks. Types of reed included the [[Bambooi]], native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]],<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref> [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi's]] [[kishu reed]],<ref name="SoR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref> the [[razor reed]] of [[Trinta]],<ref name="DoE">''[[Domain of Evil]]''</ref> the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[lumen reed]],<ref name="TFP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref> and the [[siphon reed]].<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

On Kabal, the [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunter]] [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]] had swaths of reeds including Bambooi spread across the grounds of his [[Tyro Viveca's estate|estate]]. Viveca often used them to hide traps on his property, including obscuring the opening of a [[Ralltiir tiger pit]] and to conceal the control unit of an [[R-TechApp Man Trap]].<ref name="FP" />
